newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Intel hit by downdraft.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Intel hit by downdraft.

text.p: Shares in Intel Corp dropped more than half a point in after-hours trade on Friday, a decline that dealers attributed to catch-up transactions after a major sell-off in the broader market during regular trade.
"It's probably just a continuation of the down market," a trader said. He said the microprocessor maker traded at 91-1/2 after closing unofficially at 92-1/8.
Intel had closed down 3-3/4 points during regular-hours trade, a session that saw the Dow Jones Industrial average slump by 247 points -- its second biggest point loss ever -- to close at 7695.
Other stocks traded in line with their closing prices after the bell, traders said, capping a choppy week during which the Dow retreated more than 330 points overall.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 99,300 compared with 7,900 for the previous day, and session two volume was 7.4 million, compared with 1.7 million.
